prompts.title: Récord reciente · grouped form bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion sequence, about 8 seconds, for Croacia vs España in the Nations competition. Layout: full-bleed GoatLab charcoal #101412, with one focal point — a grouped bar chart filling the upper two-thirds. The lower quarter is permanently reserved for yellow subtitles (flat yellow band, charcoal text) and must never be overlapped by chart, axis or captions. Typography: bold condensed title "Récord reciente" in warm white #edf0e6, small uppercase eyebrow "CROACIA VS ESPAÑA · NATIONS", grotesque axis and value type. All on-screen Spanish labels. Colour: Croacia bars lime #c5ed74, España bars slate #8ca6bf, warm white grid at low opacity. Chart type: three category groups on one shared zero baseline — "Victorias", "Empates", "Derrotas" — each group holding a Croacia bar and an España bar. Common scale: linear, from zero up to just above the largest of {{home.wins}}, {{away.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{away.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.losses}}; axis title "Partidos", values {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} printed above their bars with the unit. Sample treatment: a caption line in Spanish reads "Muestra: Croacia {{home.n}} partidos · España {{away.n}} partidos — tamaños de muestra distintos si difieren", followed by a source caption resolving from the fact source fields (provider Bzzoiro). Temporal stages: 0 to 1.4s title clip reveal; 1.4 to 2.6s baseline draws left to right and ticks fade up; 2.6 to 5.8s bars grow from zero with staggered ease-out, paired bars offset slightly; 5.8 to 7.2s emphasis — a lime bracket sweeps across {{home.wins}} victorias against {{away.wins}}, while the {{home.draws}} zero gets a thin underline flash; 7.2 to 8s hold. Entry animation: charcoal wipe from the top edge. Camera: restrained push-in and return, no parallax. transition: slide-up into the following card.

prompts.title: Goles a favor y en contra · paired bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion graphics, about 7 seconds. Layout: charcoal #101412 field; the paired bar chart occupies the upper two-thirds as the single focal point; the lower quarter is permanently yellow subtitles (yellow band, charcoal text) and stays clear of every label. Typography: bold Spanish title "Goles a favor y en contra" in warm white #edf0e6, eyebrow "ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS · NATIONS"; all Spanish labels: "Croacia", "España", "Goles a favor", "Goles recibidos", axis title "Goles", unit "goles". Colour: Croacia lime #c5ed74, España slate #8ca6bf, warm white numerals. Chart type: two category groups ("Goles a favor", "Goles recibidos"), each containing a Croacia bar and an España bar, all on one shared zero baseline and one shared linear scale running from zero to just above the largest of {{home.gf}}, {{away.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.ga}} — same unit, so the comparison is unambiguous. Football context: a thin centre-circle pitch motif behind the plot, a small goal-frame glyph beside "Goles recibidos", a ball glyph landing on the tallest bar. Data labels above the bars carry {{home.gf}}, {{away.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.ga}} with the unit. Sample and source treatment beneath the baseline in Spanish: "Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos de Croacia · {{away.n}} partidos de España", plus a source caption resolved from the fact source fields (provider Bzzoiro), sample size attached. Temporal stages: 0 to 1.2s title clip reveal; 1.2 to 2.2s pitch lines draw and the baseline extends; 2.2 to 5.0s paired bars grow upward with stagger; 5.0 to 6.2s emphasis — an animated warm white bracket measures the gap between {{home.gf}} and {{away.gf}}, while the received-goals pair dims to preserve one focal point; 6.2 to 7s hold. Entry animation: centre mask wipe. Camera: gentle push-in within the 9:16 frame. transition: fade through charcoal to the next card.

prompts.title: Arcos en cero · counts with sample
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion sequence, about 6 seconds, on GoatLab charcoal #101412. Focal point: a two-row horizontal bar chart of clean-sheet counts, presented strictly as counts — never converted into rates or shares. The upper area holds the chart; the lower quarter is a permanent yellow subtitle band (yellow ground, charcoal text) that no label may enter. Typography: bold Spanish title "Arcos en cero" in warm white #edf0e6, eyebrow "DEFENSA · ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS", row labels "Croacia" and "España", bar-end values with unit "partidos", axis title "Partidos sin encajar". All Spanish labels; colour: Croacia lime #c5ed74, España slate #8ca6bf, warm white grid at low opacity. Chart type: horizontal bars from a shared zero baseline on the left, common linear scale from zero to just above the larger of {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}. Bar ends read {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}. Sample treatment: beside each row a small square marker plus Spanish caption "Muestra: Croacia {{home.n}} partidos" and "Muestra: España {{away.n}} partidos", so the two counts are read against their own samples and no division is performed. Source treatment: a caption with the word source, resolving from the fact source fields (provider Bzzoiro), sample size attached. Temporal stages: 0 to 1.2s title clip reveal and eyebrow fade; 1.2 to 2.0s baseline draws and sample chips slide in from the right; 2.0 to 4.2s bars extend with ease-out while their integers step up from zero; 4.2 to 5.4s emphasis — the larger count takes a soft glow pulse and a thin bracket marks the difference in counts, sample chips hold still; 5.4 to 6s hold. Entry animation: charcoal wipe. Camera: locked off with a slight horizontal drift. transition: fade to charcoal before the next card.

prompts.title: Cruces previos · historical counts
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion sequence, about 7 seconds, on GoatLab charcoal #101412. Layout: one focal point — a stacked horizontal bar of previous meetings, centred in the upper two-thirds; the lower quarter is permanently yellow subtitles (yellow band, charcoal text), untouched by chart or captions. Typography: bold Spanish title "Cruces previos" in warm white #edf0e6, eyebrow "HISTORIAL · NO ES PRONÓSTICO"; all Spanish labels: "Croacia", "Empates", "España", "Partidos", axis title "Cruces históricos". Colour: Croacia segment lime #c5ed74, draws segment warm white #edf0e6 at reduced opacity, España segment slate #8ca6bf. Chart type: a single stacked bar on a shared zero baseline and a linear scale running from zero to {{h2h.total}}, split into {{h2h.homeWins}} victorias de Croacia, {{h2h.draws}} empates and {{h2h.awayWins}} victorias de España; below it a slim grouped bar repeats the same three counts on the identical scale for direct reading. Values {{h2h.homeWins}}, {{h2h.draws}}, {{h2h.awayWins}} are printed with the unit "partidos" and reconcile visibly to {{h2h.total}}. Sample and source treatment in Spanish: "Muestra: {{h2h.total}} cruces previos — datos históricos, no un pronóstico" plus a source caption resolving from the fact source fields (provider Bzzoiro), sample size attached. Temporal stages: 0 to 1.3s title clip reveal; 1.3 to 2.3s baseline draws and the empty bar outline fades in; 2.3 to 5.0s segments fill left to right with staggered ease-out, labels snapping on as each segment closes; 5.0 to 6.2s emphasis — the España segment pulses in slate and a thin warm white bracket spans {{h2h.homeWins}} against {{h2h.awayWins}}; 6.2 to 7s hold. Entry animation: top-down mask wipe. Camera: slight push-in and return within 9:16. transition: horizontal slide into the next card.

prompts.title: Tensión · forma reciente frente a historial
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion sequence, about 9 seconds, on GoatLab charcoal #101412. One focal point: a two-panel grouped bar chart that summarises a single grounded statistical tension — recent wins versus historical wins, in the same unit. Layout: panel A "Últimos partidos" on top, panel B "Cruces previos" beneath, both above the lower quarter, which is permanently reserved for yellow subtitles (yellow band, charcoal text). Typography: bold Spanish title "Tensión: forma frente a historial" in warm white #edf0e6, eyebrow "CROACIA VS ESPAÑA · NATIONS"; all Spanish labels: "Croacia", "España", "Victorias", "Empates", axis title "Partidos". Colour: Croacia lime #c5ed74, España slate #8ca6bf, warm white grid at low opacity. Chart type: panel A shows two bars, {{home.wins}} for Croacia and {{away.wins}} for España, on a shared zero baseline; panel B shows {{h2h.homeWins}}, {{h2h.draws}} and {{h2h.awayWins}} on its own shared zero baseline. Panels use the same unit but their own scales, each scale labelled, and a connector line states the differing samples so the tension is read honestly and no forecast is implied. Sample and source treatment in Spanish: "Muestra A: Croacia {{home.n}} · España {{away.n}} partidos" and "Muestra B: {{h2h.total}} cruces previos", followed by a source caption resolved from the fact source fields (provider Bzzoiro), sample size attached; only published history appears — no model estimate is shown. Temporal stages: 0 to 1.6s title clip reveal; 1.6 to 3.4s panel A baseline draws and its bars grow with stagger; 3.4 to 5.6s panel B slides up and its three segments fill left to right; 5.6 to 7.6s emphasis — a warm white bracket links {{away.wins}} with {{h2h.awayWins}} while Croacia's pair dims slightly; 7.6 to 9s hold. Entry animation: charcoal wipe from the top. Camera: slow push-in, then locked. transition: fade through charcoal to the closing card.
